checks.details: One complete toy snapshot created; caller input unchanged.
Create retry uses same resource identity without an additional resource.
Create transaction ID reused for different intent conflicts.
Two simulated simultaneous Save As commands with the same label create distinct stable IDs.
Load of missing resource returns NotFound.
Completion, edge decision and Unresolved are one accepted revision2 with unchanged baseline.
Identical conditional commit retry is idempotent, not a new event or revision.
Reused commit ID with changed complete candidate conflicts.
Old expected revision rejects without overwrite.
Changed baseline rejects before persistence.
Removing an existing baseline rejects.
Malformed toy candidate rejects; not validation of actual Bugsys schema.
Unknown illustrative model returns Unsupported.
Commit to missing resource never recreates it.
Injected quota failure before toy critical-section write leaves saved data unchanged.
Injected security failure before toy critical-section write leaves saved data unchanged.
Simulated unavailable coordination fails closed; no real browser lock exercised.
Preparing/cancelling a local draft without invoking commit makes no saved change.
Simulated write-before-publication/lost acknowledgement reconciles through retry; not a crash durability test.
Old successful retry returns original receipt and current revision separately; no UI rollback to old candidate.
One same-base write wins under the fake synchronous critical section; other conflicts. Not actual parallel browser proof.
Rewriting old historical facts rejects; corrections must append.
Object-memory export -> serialized-memory import preserves toy lineage/task IDs/history/revision/baseline, with a new repository ID.
Changing transport export metadata does not alter semantic snapshot fingerprint.
Reverse fake-adapter transfer is lossless; no real API/DBMS or format6 exercised.
Fresh imported resource can conditionally commit at the preserved logical revision; receipts are repository-local.
Toy completion without its evidence rejects as a whole, not partially applied.
Same counter with externally changed content fails fingerprint comparison; this is not cryptographic protection from external editing.
